summary: Ensysce Biosciences filed an 8-K disclosing Nasdaq delisting notices. Nasdaq determined compliance with the stockholders' equity rule but requires evidence in the next periodic report; also granted a 180-day extension to February 22, 2027, to regain the $1.00 minimum bid price. Additionally, Nasdaq flagged the Cy Biopharma acquisition as a change of control, requiring the post-transaction entity to meet initial listing criteria and complete the initial listing process before preferred stock conversion. The company plans to submit an initial listing application. Watch for periodic report compliance and listing application outcome.
